additions.reason: The Torah explicitly equates 'יוֹחַאי אַבָּא' (= the Torah) with 'בְּחִינַת הַחֲסָדִים מִצַּד הָאָב.' The revelation of Torah IS the revelation of the paternal hasadim. This concept is the source from which gadlut/malkhut (Package 2) flows: one who has hasadim from the father can reveal Torah and bring others to gadlut. The hasadim-from-the-father concept shares nature with malkhut/gadlut as the positive generative force behind Torah revelation. However — this connection may be eitza rather than bechina (the hasadim produce gadlut rather than being the same as gadlut). Flagged for review.

additions.reason: R' Shimon explicitly says 'אֲנִי אוֹמַר לְהַתּוֹרָה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת יוֹחַאי אַבָּא' — the Torah (as revealed through R' Shimon) is a bechina of Yochai his father, specifically as the hasadim from the paternal side. 'יוֹחַאי אַבָּא' is a symbolic name for the source of Torah revelation. This belongs in the positive domain alongside malkhut/gadlut as part of the Torah-revelation cluster.

additions.reason: The Rebbe cites the verse from Shir HaShirim 'מֶלֶךְ אָסוּר בָּרְהָטִים' and immediately interprets it as 'בְּרַהֲטֵי מֹחִין' — the King (God) held/bound in the channels of the mind. This is bechina language: the verse is a bechina of the concept of divinity drawn into the mind (Package 3). The verse-figure is another expression of the same reality as the 'drawing of divinity into rihitei mochin' and tephisa.

analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror: Package 1 (מרקוליס / חלוף הכבוד) is the evil mirror of the Torah-honor cluster (כבוד התורה / כבוד ה). The positive concept כבוד ה / כבוד התורה (which brings rain) has a perfect evil mirror in חלוף הכבוד / מרקוליס (which causes drought). Package 2 (malkhut/gadlut) and Package 3 (drawing of divinity) are both good; their evil mirror would be the realm of טומאה / unworthy minds that capture divinity in the wrong place — alluded to in the text's punishment of 'tephisa' for teaching Torah to unworthy students (this evil mirror is implicit rather than explicit in the dataset).
